mainEntity.name: Will an AI chief of staff actually make money, or is it just another productivity experiment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Treat the system as a workflow for producing reviewed work, not as an automatic revenue machine. It may help research an offer, draft a digital product, prepare a sales page, organize emails, or generate promotional ideas, but customer demand, positioning, quality, distribution, and execution still determine results. Run My AI Business distinguishes demonstrated workflows from experimental or not-yet-used examples, and the 38-bot library does not establish 38 independent income-producing businesses. Track practical measures such as hours spent, revision rounds, completion rate, qualified responses, subscriber actions, or sales—not just the number of tasks assigned. Stop or redesign a workflow that creates more checking than useful work.
acceptedAnswer.description: It can improve organization and help prepare research, products, marketing, and operations, but it cannot guarantee income. Measure completed work, review time, subscriber actions, qualified responses, and sales. Treat bot examples as adaptable workflows, not 38 proven businesses or automatic revenue streams.
